message.text: I am looking for the outbound webhook delivery function and its protection against internal network addresses.
Checking the internal/webhook package to locate the outbound delivery execution point.
Reading webhook files to locate where outbound notifications trigger from memo changes.

I am checking `memo_service_webhooks.go` to confirm the delivery flow. `PostAsync` enqueues requests, while `Post` performs the actual HTTP delivery.

`Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` executes the outbound HTTP delivery. Worker goroutines from the async queue call it. `safeDialContext` in `webhook.go` blocks reserved and private IPs during dialing. `ValidateURL` in `validate.go` rejects URLs with reserved CIDR addresses when creating or updating webhooks.

The shared `reservedCIDRs` logic in `validate.go` underpins both the runtime dial-time guard and the upfront URL validation.
Checking tests for safeDialContext and SSRF protection to confirm naming.
Searching for validation tests related to outbound HTTP delivery.

I will identify the outbound delivery function and its protection mechanism, then cite their file paths.

The delivery function is `Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. It performs the actual HTTP POST via `safeClient.Do(req)`. Runtime protection during delivery is `safeDialContext` in the same file. This guards against SSRF by blocking reserved IP ranges. Registration-time validation is handled by `ValidateURL` in `validate.go`, which uses `isReservedIP` against `reservedCIDRs`.
